children: The investigation into last year's Air India crash that killed 260 people is in its final stage, the Indian government said on Wednesday.

"We are at the fag end (of the investigation)," Solicitor General Tushar Mehta told the Supreme Court, which is hearing a petition by the father of the flight's captain, Sumeet Sabharwal, seeking a separate independent investigation into the accident.
Mehta asked the court to adjourn the case for two to three weeks.
